moments.text: Infrared view of drifting white cloud against darker grey, crosshair at centre; black side bars and redaction boxes.
A tiny pale dot shows upper left of the crosshair and grows clearer as the cloud below thins.
Playback freezes; a white circle is drawn around the dot, labelled "U/I SMALL THERMAL SIGNATURE".
Playback resumes with a white flash, then a grainy, flat grey view; the pale dot is faint at upper left.
After a second white flash a clearer textured grey view returns; the tiny pale dot stays at upper left, near the top redaction box.
A bright white cloud mass drifts in at the upper right and slides down the right side of the frame.
The scene changes to lighter, mottled texture with a bright patch at upper left.
The picture turns flat light grey as the clip ends.

notes: Black side bars not cropped (crop null).
